title: Integrative dissection of gene regulatory elements at base resolution.
authors: Chen, Zeyu; Javed, Nauman; Moore, Molly; Wu, Jingyi; Sun, Gary; Vinyard, Michael; Collins, Alejandro; Pinello, Luca; Najm, Fadi J; Bernstein, Bradley E
one_liner_zh: 该文结合碱基编辑与深度学习解析CD69增强子内关键碱基对TF-DNA调控互作的影响，虽聚焦基因调控元件而非直接TF-DNA结合建模，但方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作研究。
abstract: Although vast numbers of putative gene regulatory elements have been cataloged, the sequence motifs and individual bases that underlie their functions remain largely unknown. Here, we combine epigenetic perturbations, base editing, and deep learning to dissect regulatory sequences within the exemplar immune locus encoding CD69. We converge on a  approximately 170 base interval within a differentially accessible and acetylated enhancer critical for CD69 induction in stimulated Jurkat T cells. Individual C-to-T base edits within the interval markedly reduce element accessibility and acetylation, with corresponding reduction of CD69 expression. The most potent base edits may be explained by their effect on regulatory interactions between the transcriptional activators GATA3 and TAL1 and the repressor BHLHE40. Systematic analysis suggests that the interplay between GATA3 and BHLHE40 plays a general role in rapid T cell transcriptional responses. Our study provides a framework for parsing regulatory elements in their endogenous chromatin contexts and identifying operative artificial variants.
abstract_zh: 尽管已有大量推定基因调控元件被编目，但支撑其功能的序列基序和单个碱基在很大程度上仍属未知。在此，我们结合表观遗传扰动、碱基编辑和深度学习，剖析编码CD69的示例性免疫位点内的调控序列。我们聚焦于一个约170碱基的区间，该区间位于一个差异可及且乙酰化的增强子内，对刺激的Jurkat T细胞中CD69的诱导至关重要。该区间内的单个C-to-T碱基编辑显著降低元件可及性和乙酰化水平，并相应减少CD69表达。最有效的碱基编辑可归因于其对转录激活因子GATA3和TAL1与抑制因子BHLHE40之间调控相互作用的影响。系统分析表明，GATA3与BHLHE40之间的相互作用在快速T细胞转录反应中发挥普遍作用。我们的研究为在内源染色质环境中解析调控元件及识别功能性人工变异提供了一个框架。
